verdict: Google profiles are active; paid channels and outreach pipeline need to launch.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, your Google Business Profiles generated 455 total actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — with no paid advertising running on any channel. GBP engagement softened in the most recent week, down roughly 25–31% across each profile, with the last three days of the period showing near-zero activity; this is being investigated alongside a broader review of profile visibility. Overdue work on contact data, outreach sequences, and CRM reconciliation has limited the outreach pipeline, and those items are being closed out now with an October 31 completion target. Once those foundations are in place and paid campaigns are activated, lead volume will have the fuel it currently lacks.

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement dropped sharply in the final three days of the period across all profiles, and two O'Hare-affiliated profiles recorded zero calls despite receiving combined impressions this period.
watch_item.fix: Profile contact details and visibility settings are being reviewed now, and a site reindexing effort targeting all three brands is on track for completion by October 31.
